# Git

Repo settings for the Git standard (skill `iivanou-git-standards`). Re-run `/iivanou-git-standards:setup` to change them.

<!-- generated by iivanou-git-standards v0.3.0, do not edit [sum 304781140] above this line; Setup never rewrites what follows -->

## Branches and releases

`develop` is the default branch: day-to-day work lands there. `main` moves only by release (ADR-0007): the release step on `develop` bumps the version, adds a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, commits `release: claude-cost vX.Y.Z`, tags it, fast-forwards `main`, and pushes `develop`, `main` and the tag. CI on the tag publishes the GitHub Release.
